stories.title: [Setup] Publish the shared baseline, CI, and assigned dependency graph
stories.story: As a developer, I can find the agreed product, run the repository checks, and select an assigned issue whose prerequisites are complete.
acceptance: Canonical documentation is available on the repository's main branch.
CI checks repository documentation and the issue graph, and runs app quality gates once a package manifest exists.
Pull requests must reference a real issue and the dependency check fails while that issue has open blockers.
All P0 stories have one owner, a peer reviewer, explicit file ownership, and native GitHub dependencies.
A peer-review and required-check rule protects main if the repository plan supports it; any platform restriction is documented accurately.
stories.verification: Run node scripts/check-project.mjs and observe a successful GitHub Actions run. Verify issue assignees and native dependencies through the GitHub API.
stories.scope: Repository setup only; no application feature is claimed as implemented.

stories.title: [P0] Open a persistent four-page demo shell with shared contracts
stories.story: As a demo participant, I can choose a labelled scenario, navigate the four page slots, switch simulated roles, and reset or resume the same local demo.
acceptance: Scaffold the agreed React, TypeScript, and Vite app with npm ci, dev, typecheck, lint, test, build, and preview scripts; commit the lockfile.
Implement contract v1 from docs/contracts.md and the shared local persistence transaction interface; export stable feature interfaces.
Create the four page slots and feature entry placeholders listed in the contract; placeholders say not implemented and have no fake completion action.
Select start-from-zero, growth-checkpoint, or restoration scenarios without claiming unimplemented learning behavior; the role switch remains visibly a same-browser simulation.
Persist through one runtime adapter; a failed write reports failure without silently committing only part of the state; reset selects a fresh run and retains scenario/source labels.
Meaningful runtime tests verify refresh restoration, reset isolation, unknown schema handling, and storage failure; existing CI remains green.
Limit src/features/ edits to initial entry placeholders; subsequent issues own those directories.
stories.verification: Run npm ci, npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm test, and npm run build. Open all four slots, switch roles, refresh, reset, and test a storage failure.
stories.scope: Freeze contracts and shell first. No grading engine, full learner flow, mentor workflow, or automatic advancement belongs in this issue.

stories.title: [P0] Supply the six reviewed cases and reproducible demo histories
stories.story: As a learner or presenter, I receive internally consistent fictional cases, reviewed hints, and clearly labelled demonstration history.
acceptance: Create the six interactive cases EX-01, WK-01, CK-01, TR-01, UN-01, and RT-01 using the JSON contract in docs/contracts.md and product section 8.
Include facts, accepted structured answers, evidence and rationale IDs, L1–L4 hints, draft truth/origin, task routing data, and case/skill mappings.
Publish four task cards and three skill-card definitions; only cross-period expense allocation has a complete learning path.
Growth seed has eight eligible checks in one stage: six correct at 75% and two correct at 50%, with two distinct regular checks and linked retention at least 72 hours after teaching; E3 is missing.
Historical case IDs are distinct from the six interactive IDs; four AI review events yield a labelled historical 1/4 wrong-draft acceptance count and do not enter E5.
Restoration seed has a valid teaching/retention link; start-from-zero has no historical evidence; all scenario provenance is explicit.
The dependency-free content checker verifies references, structured answers, teaching links, timestamps, and the documented Brier values.
Record who reviewed the content and whether review was team-only; do not claim an external accounting review.
stories.verification: Run node scripts/check-content.mjs and node --test scripts/tests/content.test.mjs before an app scaffold exists. Confirm WK-01=400, TR-01=0, RT-01=500 and that UN-01 needs more information.
stories.scope: JSON content and its validator can begin immediately, using contract v1. Do not change application types, app shell, package files, or CI workflow.

stories.title: [P0] Review WK-01 with staged help and persistent judgment
stories.story: As Lin, I can make a judgment, choose confidence, obtain appropriate help, and then accept, correct, or request information about the AI draft.
acceptance: WK-01 renders case facts, answer/action, evidence and reason choices, prior confidence, and the five-level support display.
The AI draft stays hidden until judgment submission; confidence is immutable after submission; refresh never reveals information early.
At L2, offer L1 or L2 hints directly and record actual maximum help used; demonstration escape records L3/L4 assistance without altering the configured level.
Grade structured amount/action plus evidence and rationale using reviewed content; a right amount with a wrong reason is not an independent success.
Persist draft disclosure and accept/correct/need_info review events exactly once; an incorrect draft contributes to the metric only once revealed.
Practice attempts never count toward E1 or E5; source labels survive refresh and repeated actions are idempotent.
Expose the learner commands and view specified by contract v1 for later live integration; feature behavior works from its own route without needing a completed mentor flow.
stories.verification: Run feature tests plus the repository gates. Exercise WK-01 at desktop and narrow widths using keyboard only; refresh before and after reveal, request help, correct the 1,200 draft to 400, and repeat submission.
stories.scope: Own the complete learner practice slice. Leave progress evaluation, mentor state, metrics, and cross-feature orchestration to their owners.

stories.title: [P0] Preview a help request and publish a reviewed experience card
stories.story: As Lin and Supervisor Chen, we can share a precise question, exchange a reasoned reply, and choose whether to publish reusable experience.
acceptance: A learner can select context, edit the question, and preview the exact help request before sending; cancelling produces no shared request.
The mentor sees only that previewed content and summary evidence, not all private attempts.
A reply creates a fixed-template experience-card draft using the mentor's own words; allow edit, publish, and reply-only.
A published card is an independent approved content copy with source attribution, applicability, exception, and version; private transcript access is not inherited.
Unpublished, disputed, and retired cards are excluded from shared feedback selectors; publishing is idempotent and persists across refresh.
Provide the request composer, mentor page, and published-feedback selector through the agreed interface.
Demonstrate the complete request-to-card workflow using an explicitly labelled sample attempt on the standalone feature route; live WK-01 wiring belongs to integration.
stories.verification: Run feature tests and repository gates. Check cancel/send/reply-only/publish flows, refresh, private-context separation, and duplicate publication.
stories.scope: No model call, multi-user authentication, open knowledge search, or global store rewrite.

stories.title: [P0] Complete a fresh independent check without answer leakage
stories.story: As Lin, I can attempt TR-01 independently, receive feedback after submitting, and obtain help by leaving the challenge.
acceptance: A fresh TR-01 hides relevant help, answer, AI draft, and experience feedback until submission.
Correctly grade zero expense in December from the structured choices and preserve the prior confidence.
Record independence at submission; later feedback preserves this check's eligibility but makes subsequent attempts at the same case practice-only.
Exposure persists across refresh and stages; changing a case version or reopening it does not create a fresh case.
Exiting to view a demonstration records assisted learning, not a scored failure or independent success.
An interrupted unseen check resumes its existing attempt without duplicate observations; unknown case versions remain ungraded.
If no fresh suitable case remains, show missing evidence and allow practice; no automatic question generation.
Expose the submitted attempt to the integration coordinator through contract v1; progression is handled by the progress feature.
stories.verification: Run feature tests for exposure, interruption, exit, duplicate submissions, and refresh. Complete a 75%-confidence TR-01, view feedback, and prove a retry cannot produce independent evidence.
stories.scope: Extend the same learning module after practice merges; do not change evidence thresholds or the progress engine.

stories.title: [P0] Explain support fading, restoration, and mentor review
stories.story: As Lin and my mentor, we can see why a support level changed, what evidence remains missing, and why further fading is blocked.
acceptance: Implement E1–E5 from the product and accepted decisions through a pure evaluator over the agreed attempt, stage, exposure, teaching-link, and concern records.
Growth history plus a qualifying TR-01 produces exactly one L2→L1 transition; store the closing-stage evidence snapshot and begin a fresh pending stage.
Transfer/retention failure restores support once; a simultaneous 90%-confidence error creates a concern without applying a second restoration.
At L0/L4, clamp level changes without creating a fictitious stage; failed evidence cannot remain marked passed.
Mentor resolution records actor/time/reason, keeps the original error, and does not grant a pass; unresolved concerns survive stage changes.
The growth page shows current-stage pending evidence separately from the completed stage's transition explanation, with dates, types, sample sizes, and origin labels.
Retention linkage is immutable; later teaching does not reset completed evidence in the same stage; old stage evidence cannot satisfy new gates.
The complete feature can be verified with labelled fixtures and an explicit demonstration harness before live integration.
stories.verification: Run meaningful evaluator and growth-view tests covering the accepted decision table, seed Brier=0.109375, ninth-record Brier≈0.1042, idempotency, failed retention, high-confidence concerns, and stage boundaries.
stories.scope: Own the progress engine and growth presentation. Do not write learner attempt state or mentoring state; the shared coordinator connects them later.

stories.title: [P0] Route work opportunities and demonstrate a correct AI draft
stories.story: As Lin, I can understand why a task is assigned to me, AI, or a mentor, and practise accepting a correct AI draft as well as correcting an incorrect one.
acceptance: Render four fixed tasks in the learning-value × delivery-risk view with a text explanation for each route.
High-risk delivery belongs to the mentor; practice-copy labels do not imply real business execution.
Open WK-01 through the learner interface; other explanatory task cards have no fake completion action.
Expose CK-01 as the correct-draft contrast and accept 100 with the reviewed rationale without teaching blanket AI rejection.
Preview UN-01's missing performance evidence without making it a second mandatory live graded question.
Show three skill cards and label the two incomplete learning paths as example states.
Use the frozen entry points so app-shell files do not need concurrent edits.
stories.verification: Run routing and correct-draft tests. Check the four routes, WK-01 navigation, CK-01 acceptance, UN-01 preview, keyboard focus, and narrow-screen layout.
stories.scope: Only this owner may extend learner entry behavior. It can follow PRACTICE independently of the mentor/progress branches; do not work on it concurrently with another unmerged branch touching learning.

stories.title: [P0] Show honest mentor metrics and learning trends
stories.story: As a mentor, I can distinguish assisted performance, independent checks, wrong-draft acceptance, and simulated observations.
acceptance: Compute the wrong-draft acceptance tile from known-incorrect drafts actually revealed, separating session and demo_seed events.
Expose zero denominators honestly; CK-01 correct drafts do not enter the wrong-draft denominator.
Compute assistance trends from actual maximum help on submitted practice attempts and independent correctness from eligible check outcomes.
Display sample size, source and case type, with explicit counts for assisted exits, interruptions, and ungraded records.
Show high-confidence errors separately; do not infer copying, motivation, or statistical mastery from the curves.
Historical and live observations have both visual and text distinctions; mentors receive summaries rather than private transcripts.
The metrics panel works from agreed read-only state and fixtures and needs no changes to learner, mentor, or progress internals.
stories.verification: Run selector tests for zero denominator, duplicate reveal, known-correct drafts, assistance versus configured level, mixed origins, and ineligible attempts. Inspect desktop and narrow-screen presentation.
stories.scope: Own the insights slice. The final integration mounts it in the mentor view through the predeclared slot.

stories.title: [P0] Connect the live practice–mentor–transfer demonstration
stories.story: As a presenter, I can run the full three-minute story with real persisted changes from each feature and replay it from reset.
acceptance: Compose WK-01 judgment/review, the actual previewed help request, mentor publication, fresh TR-01, experience feedback, and one support transition.
Submission grading and progress evaluation commit in one persisted transaction; failures cannot leave a half-updated attempt/stage and retries cannot duplicate effects.
TR-01 feedback cites the latest eligible published card after submission only; peer feature callbacks are wired through the agreed interfaces.
Render the real opportunity view, growth state, mentor metrics, and live session 0/1 beside simulated 1/4; do not substitute a seeded card for the card just published.
At L1, show the next practice with L1 available and L2 withdrawn; the closed stage's proof and new stage's pending evidence remain distinguishable.
Reset success and restoration scenarios independently; preserve simulation labels and source distinctions across refresh.
Complete integration tests for the success path, restoration path, repeated submission, refresh before reveal, and interrupted write.
Update the demo runbook with exact click paths and actual verification results.
stories.verification: Run npm ci, typecheck, lint, tests, and build. Follow the three-minute script twice from reset and run the separate RT-01 failure demonstration.
stories.scope: This is the sole cross-feature wiring issue. A defect inside another feature goes to its owner; do not silently rewrite their module while they have active work.

stories.title: [P0] Verify the accessible demo and record the delivery handoff
stories.story: As the team, we can confidently demonstrate the accepted P0 on desktop and narrow screens and explain exactly what was verified.
acceptance: Verify the product section 14 checklist against the integrated app, including keyboard operation, visible focus, enlarged text, source labels, and privacy previews.
Rehearse the full success path twice and the separate restoration branch; record timing and results rather than claiming unrun checks.
Record team-only content review and any observed participant feedback with actual sample counts; do not fabricate user research.
Record the chosen preview/deployment URL only once it is live and verified, plus the tested local backup commands; coordinate hosting changes with the integrator.
File concrete failing behaviors as follow-up issues owned by the responsible feature owner; do not close this issue while a demo-blocking defect is open.
Human reviewer confirms the delivered scope and the final demonstration handoff.
stories.verification: Human walkthrough plus available end-to-end checks. Record browser/viewports, commit, actual results, remaining limitations, and the accessible demo or local fallback.
stories.scope: Human acceptance and handoff. Hosting selection is coordinated with @samhouhaoyang; this issue does not authorize unreviewed feature rewrites.
